title: BCC Ruling No. 05-53-1067 — stair riser uniformity
code_edition: Ontario Building Code, Regulation 403 (as cited; edition label unspecified)

facts.text: The record describes an as-installed basement stair in a one-storey Group C dwelling; the top and bottom risers were each about 6 mm taller than the other risers.
The dispute cites Sentence 9.8.2.1.(1), requiring uniform tread rise and run within one flight.
facts.locator: Ruling §2, Provisions of the Building Code in Dispute

facts.text: The applicant said alterations to address the variation could create a tripping hazard at the nosing.
